descripcion: Say hello, say your name, ask what and the sounds of the German.
Countries, professions, the verb «sein», the regular present and the order of the sentence.
Count, say age, family, verb «haben» and accusative.
The three genera, the plural, «kein», «es gibt» and where is every thing.
The routine, the separable verbs, the time, the days and the frequency.
What you like, order in a cafeteria and the amounts.
Clothing, demonstrative, prices and comparison.
Places, indications, transport and the modal verbs.
Afitions, the time it makes, dates, plans and invitations.
«War» and «hatte», the Perfekt, the hotel and health.
Parts of the body and discomfort, the timing of the pronouns, prepositions with dative and tips with «sollen».
Professions in feminine, preset verbs and «würde» and «könnte» to order with courtesy.
Prepositions of place with dative and accusative, possessive and house.
Prayer with «weil», «dass», «wenn» and «obwohl».
Comparative, superlative and «so… wie».
Präteritum of «sein», «haben» and the modal verbs, and regular and irregular verbs.
Dative and accusative with two objects, dates and prepositions of time.
Future with «werden», reflective verbs and citations.
Relative prayers in nominative and accusative.
«man», indefinite pronouns, «deshalb» and «trotzdem», and final examination.
Temporary prayers with «nachdem», «bevor», «während», «bis» and «seitdem», and the perfect plastic.
Unreal conditions with «wenn … hätte», «würde» and «wäre», and tips with «an deiner Stelle».
Process liability in present and preterito, distinction with state passive, and verb «lassen».
Verbs with preposition and adverbial pronouns, the reflective dative and «brauchen … zu».
Infinitive with «zu», «um … zu», «ohne … zu», «statt … zu» and «damit».
Relative prayers with preposition and in dative, and the relative «was» and «wo».
The genitive, the «wegen», «trotz» and «während» prepositions, and the declining weak masculine.
Consequences and contrast connectors, and pairs like «sowohl … als auch» and «weder … noch».
Declination of the adjective in all four cases, comparative, superlative and modal particles.
The future with «werden», assumptions, time review and final examination.
Indirect style with Konjunktiv I: say what another person said, and the forms sei, habe and werde.
State liability, «sich lassen» and «sein + zu + infinitivo» constructions as a passive alternative.
Nominalization and verbalization, and the modal verbs of supposition.
Particulars used as adjectives and infinitive with «um … zu» and «anstatt … zu».
Prayer with «je … desto», positions and infinitive in general phrases.
Declination of the in-depth adjective and «sofern» and «insofern» connectors.
«zumal», «indem», «solange», «sobald» and «als ob» connectors.
Konjunktiv II of the past, indirect style in the past and «anstatt dass».
Passive with manners, Perfekt («ist … worden»), passive with formal dative and alternatives.
Opinion texts: «zum einen … zum anderen», advantages and disadvantages, and final examination.
